title: Lakhmir Singh Strikes and New Champions Appear

blocks.text: When called forward, Lakhmir Singh said he was thinking the same, then pounced upon his enemy with the eagerness of a Singh who had been waiting for his opening.

Though he was pierced in the shoulder, he still mounted the elephant by catching hold of a rope and fought at such close quarters that the mighty beast itself seemed reduced to a prop in the hands of the brave.

The narrative then mocks imperial grandeur by calling a single elephant being of no use before shifting to the next Mughal response, where Mansa Ram and Daya Ram are summoned as fresh decorated challengers.
